title: A town ringed by four ranges
text: Ridgecrest is surrounded by four mountain ranges: the Sierra Nevada to the west, the Coso Range to the north, the Argus Range to the east, and the El Paso Mountains to the south. It sits in the Indian Wells Valley, in northeastern Kern County, next to the Navy's China Lake base.
